request.state: The garden hose split along its length the very first time I used it at normal water pressure, which suggests a manufacturing fault. I would like my money back for this item rather than trying a second one from the same batch.

q1.instructions: The customer explicitly asks for money back.

criteria.true: The writer asks the shop to return money that was already paid, in any form: a refund, a reimbursement, a reversed charge, or a partial repayment.
criteria.false: The writer asks for anything else, or asks for nothing. An exchange, a replacement, a repair, store credit, a discount on a later order, or a question about the refund policy are all false.
